children: Colombia’s Consumer Confidence Index fell 5.2 percentage points to 15.5% in August 2026 from July.
The decline was driven by a 7.7-point drop in the Consumer Expectations Index to 22.6% and a 1.6-point decrease in the Economic Conditions Index to 4.8%.
Consumer expectations deteriorated as households’ assessment of their economic outlook fell to 36.4% from 41.8%, while general expectations for the economy declined to 16.7% from 24.8%.
The outlook for the country’s economy fell to 14.8% from 24.3%.
Meanwhile, households’ assessment of current economic conditions declined to 5.4% from 11.1%.
Willingness to buy durable goods increased to 4.2% from 1.7%.
Compared with August 2025, the Consumer Confidence Index increased by 17.9 percentage points.

title: Colombia Consumer Confidence Falls in August
